content.json:
# Image Factory — Build Dashboard

Live view of AIB image build activity, success rates, and gallery image versions. Data sourced from Azure Activity Log.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ResourceProviderValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages'
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages/imageTemplates/run/action'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize count() by ActivityStatusValue
| project Status = ActivityStatusValue, Builds = count_

AzureActivity
| where ResourceProviderValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages'
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages/imageTemplates/run/action'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize
    Succeeded = countif(ActivityStatusValue == 'Succeeded'),
    Failed = countif(ActivityStatusValue == 'Failed')
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 7d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

AzureActivity
| where ResourceProviderValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages'
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages/imageTemplates/run/action'
| project
    Time = TimeGenerated,
    Status = ActivityStatusValue,
    Template = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[-1]),
    TriggeredBy = Caller
| order by Time desc
| take 25

content.json:
## Template Deployments — Last 30 Days

Shows when image templates were updated (Bicep deployments), indicating configuration or script changes.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ResourceProviderValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages'
| where OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.VirtualMachineImages/imageTemplates/write'
| where ActivityStatusValue == 'Succeeded'
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| project
    Time = TimeGenerated,
    Template = tostring(split(ResourceId, '/')[-1]),
    DeployedBy = Caller
| order by Time desc
